rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for treatment, including psychotherapy when the context makes the type clear.

example.english: The doctor said this therapy would take several months to work.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢種治療要做足幾個月先見效。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ne1 zung2 zi6 liu4 jiu3 zou6 zuk1 gei2 go3 jyut6 sin1 gin3 haau6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean psychotherapy rather than medical treatment in general.

example.english: I’ve been having therapy for a while, and I really feel much more relaxed.
example.traditional: 我做咗一排心理治療，個人真係放鬆咗好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 zo2 jat1 paai4 sam1 lei5 zi6 liu4 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 fong3 sung1 zo2 hou2 do1
